overview: Dr. Iyer is a pulmonary-critical physician and geriatrics-palliative care researcher in the UAB Division of Pulmonary, Allergy, and Critical Care Medicine and School of Nursing. He is UAB's first recipient of the Paul B. Beeson Emerging Leaders Career Development Award in Aging (K76) and works to integrate geriatrics and palliative care for people living with serious respiratory illnesses and their care partners and strives to help people age successfully at home and in their communities. He is the founder of @pallipulm and @geripulm which focus on bridging the fields of pulmonary medicine, palliative care, and geriatrics. He is a tireless advocate for older adults and people from historically disadvantaged communities. To that end he directs pulmonary services at Cooper Green Mercy Health Services, the county ambulatory care facility for people from Jefferson County with limited or no health insurance.
